requirements.description: The user prefers properties near healthcare services for a senior day center (CDIA). 'Near' maps to the 75th percentile of the healthcare distribution (75.06, rounded to 75).

The user explicitly requires a gross floor area of at least 360 sqm. The capacity of 18 people is not converted into a surface filter because no verified gross-area threshold per occupant was provided. The Turin location and the proximity to healthcare services are handled by the Location Agent. The future CDIA use does not affect the current typology.
